entities.summary: St. Michael's Church is an Anglican church in Brighton, England, dating from the mid-Victorian era. Located on Victoria Road in the Montpelier area, to the east of Montpelier Road, it is one of the largest churches in the city of Brighton and Hove. The church is a Grade I listed building. St Michael's Church, Brighton is a church building in Europe, established in 1861. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
